summary: The pre-market read is a rally that broadened on the surface but not across assets. The total risk score eased to 43.71 (trend_1d -0.1, trend_1w -0.39, trend_1m 1.89), still inside caution, with the regime at goldilocks and model confidence at 0.9167. The relief is genuine: VIX fell to 15.2 from 16.34 and realized vol sits at 8.2784, leaving the volatility dimension at 17.58, the lowest of the 6; the SPY one-day return of 1.0468 leaves the equity stress gate untriggered, and crypto joined in, with BTC +4.47302 to 80975, ETH +5.4696 and SOL +3.86996. Breadth, however, is only adequate: 0.6194 of 155 constituents hold above the MA200, new highs are 0.0452 (7 of 155) against new lows at 0.0258 (4 of 155), small caps are -1.0349 relative and semis -18.8016 relative. Leadership has rotated decisively away from hardware: AI software +3.7368, consumer electronics +3.5394, enterprise software +3.4133, data centers +3.1564 and cloud computing +2.8937 led, while semis leaders -0.231, robotics -0.3334 and networking -1.0893 were the 3 negative themes; AVGO -2.7448 (1w -3.8704) and AMD -0.1969 (1w -4.3028) dragged the hardware chain even as NVDA gained 1.8003. The macro anchor did not move: the 10Y held at 4.79, the 2Y at 4.39, the 10Y/2Y curve is 0.40, and the 10Y real rate rose to 2.45 from 2.44, now the 99.44 percentile, the tightest reading of this sequence. Credit still refuses to confirm stress, with HY OAS 2.66 from 2.65 and IG OAS 0.81 unchanged, while the FedWatch implied rate of 3.925 against an effective funds rate of 3.63 keeps a hike as the priced action. The CN close went the other way: all 11 A-share names in the fact layer finished lower, led by 300475.SZ -6.1272, 600584.SH -5.4862 and 002156.SZ -4.4683, with 301308.SZ -3.5119 (1w -7.9283) and 603986.SH -2.9541 (1w -6.285). Two caveats before the open: the Employment Situation lands at 2026-09-04T12:30Z with payrolls already at -23.0 from 20.0, claims 206000 from 204000 and participation 61.4 from 61.5, yet the unemployment rate improved to 4.1 from 4.2, so the two labor surveys disagree and the print can cut either way; and the China desks (clschina, wallstreetcn) arrive via RSSHub relays (trust: relay), so items such as the Norway sovereign wealth fund flagging a cut to the government bond sleeve of its $2.3T portfolio, with US Treasuries most exposed, are second-hand aggregation rather than first-party statements.

top_risk_drivers.claim: The 10Y real rate rose to 2.45 from 2.44, now the 99.44 percentile, while the 10Y held at 4.79 and the 2Y at 4.39; the macro dimension therefore stays the highest of the 6 at 63.2, with the real rate and the 10Y yield contributing 4.972 and 4.904 points.

Cross-asset confirmation sits at exactly 0.5 and is the single largest risk contributor at 7.5 points: dollar strength at 118.7479, real-rate pressure at 2.45, small-cap underperformance at -1.0349 and gold up 0.5744 all fire, while the equity drawdown, high-yield widening, bitcoin and copper gates stay silent, so the rally is confirmed only by equities and gold themselves.

The labor tape is deteriorating into the Employment Situation at 2026-09-04T12:30Z: monthly payrolls fell to -23.0 from 20.0, initial claims rose to 206000 from 204000, continuing claims to 1779000 from 1771000 and participation slipped to 61.4 from 61.5, with only the unemployment rate improving to 4.1 from 4.2.

Breadth is adequate but not convincing: 0.6194 of 155 constituents hold above the MA200, new highs are just 0.0452 (7 of 155) against 0.0258 new lows (4 of 155), small caps trail by -1.0349 and semis by -18.8016, leaving the equity structure dimension at 46.05.

The reverse-repo balance jumped to 0.702 from 0.525 while reserves fell to 2894531 from 2924936, a slow drain that leaves the reverse-repo indicator at a 90.21 risk score and a 3.6084 point contribution, the fourth-largest in the model, even as SOFR eased to 3.65 from 3.66.

supporting_signals.claim: Volatility is the clearest relief: VIX fell to 15.2 from 16.34, realized vol is 8.2784, and the volatility dimension scored just 17.58, the lowest of the 6, with the SPY one-day return of 1.0468 leaving the equity stress gate untriggered.

Credit remains the strongest disconfirmation of stress: HY OAS is 2.66 from 2.65 at the 5.46 percentile and IG OAS is unchanged at 0.81, so the high-yield widening gate stays silent and the liquidity and credit dimension sits at 36.98.

The trend block is intact: price versus the MA200 is 8.6477, the 52W drawdown is only -0.6055, 3M momentum is 2.1239, and the 10Y/2Y curve is positive at 0.40, so there is no recessionary signal in the price structure.

Risk appetite is live outside equities too: BTC +4.47302 to 80975, ETH +5.4696 to 2522.96 and SOL +3.86996 to 103.89 with BTC dominance at 0.597531, and the overnight tape quoted Nasdaq 100 futures up 0.52 at 29679 (news importance 49.93).

contradicting_signals.claim: The AI trade has split against hardware: semis leaders -0.231, robotics -0.3334 and networking -1.0893 were the only negative themes, AVGO fell -2.7448 (1w -3.8704) and AMD -0.1969 (1w -4.3028), and semis relative performance is -18.8016, so the software-led tape (AI software +3.7368, enterprise software +3.4133) is not pulling the chip complex with it.

The CN close went the other way: all 11 A-share names in the fact layer finished lower, with 300475.SZ -6.1272, 600584.SH -5.4862, 002156.SZ -4.4683 and 300223.SZ -3.6594 leading the losses, and the memory and logic chain extending its weekly slide (301308.SZ -3.5119 with 1w -7.9283, 688525.SH -3.2698, 001309.SZ -3.397).

Inflation is cooling while the policy price is not: headline CPI is 3.30386 from 3.46353 and core CPI 2.46652 from 2.56579, the 5Y5Y breakeven is flat at 2.33 and the 10Y breakeven is 2.35 from 2.34, yet the FedWatch implied rate of 3.925 sits above the 3.63 effective funds rate with a hike as the priced action.

The two labor surveys disagree, so today's report is a coin flip rather than a confirmation: payrolls are -23.0 from 20.0 and participation is 61.4 from 61.5, but the unemployment rate improved to 4.1 from 4.2 while continuing claims at 1779000 are still rising from 1771000.
